notes: image::draw: Draw/DrawMask with Go's clipping, fast paths and generic RGBA64 arithmetic (Over/Src, any mask), FloydSteinberg, Drawer/Quantizer/RGBA64Image traits; self-draw via draw_within; Quantizer takes an explicit capacity; a paletted index outside the palette and FloydSteinberg on an empty palette panic as in Go

Draw.note: A paletted pixel index outside the palette and a Floyd-Steinberg draw onto an empty palette panic, as in Go.

DrawMask.note: A paletted pixel index outside the palette and a Floyd-Steinberg draw onto an empty palette panic, as in Go.

FloydSteinberg.note: A paletted pixel index outside the palette and a Floyd-Steinberg draw onto an empty palette panic, as in Go.

Quantizer.Quantize.note: The palette capacity is an explicit argument; Rust has no slice capacity (Rust shape).
